explication: ClearPDF is an Android document toolkit. The principal workflow is selecting a local document, opening it in a format-specific viewer/editor, applying supported PDF, spreadsheet, image, or scan operations, then saving or exporting the result locally. The graph preserves README-described capabilities and the sampled Office-engine lifecycle; links for unsampled feature wiring cite the README rather than implying source-level calls. The source excerpts do not establish every screen-to-core implementation call.
